name: cPages PDF-backed (copies of different pages)
description: Modern cPages schema, PDF-backed document with 4 UI pages: 2 duplicates of page 0, 2 inserted blank pages. Tests UI ordering, page duplication, and inserted pages. Contains V6 annotations (version=6 in .rm files) - can be used for V6 annotation structure testing until pure V6 notebook fixture is available.

name: Device 'Test' (downloaded from cloud)
description: Downloaded via `remarquee cloud get /Test`. Real device document intended to exercise a variety of strokes/features for V6 parsing/rendering validation.

name: Fake cPages PDF-backed (no annotations)
description: Generated cPages PDF-backed document (4 UI pages: duplicated + inserted) with no .rm files. Exercises page plan ordering and background-only rendering paths.

name: Fake cPages PDF-backed (V6 header-only .rm)
description: Generated cPages PDF-backed document with a V6 header-only .rm file (parses but contains no blocks). Exercises "has rm file but no strokes" paths.

name: Fake cPages PDF-backed (sample V6 annotations)
description: Generated cPages PDF-backed document embedding a real V6 .rm extracted from cpage-pdf.rmdoc. Exercises stroke merge + (if present) glyph-range highlight annotation paths.

name: Fake cPages Notebook (V6 header-only .rm)
description: Generated cPages notebook-style document (no payload PDF) with V6 header-only .rm files. Exercises blank-page rendering paths.

name: Fake cPages PDF-backed (deleted pages in .content)
description: Generated cPages PDF-backed document where one cPages entry is marked deleted. Parser should filter it out (expectedPages excludes deleted).

name: Legacy V3/V5 Notebook
description: Legacy schema, notebook with 1 page. Tests legacy .content parsing, V3/V5 .rm annotation rendering via rmapi.
